description: Post update functions for Drupal Views module, including functions for updating view configurations and post-update hooks.

methods.name: views_removed_post_updates
methods.description: Returns an array of post update functions with their target Drupal core versions.

methods.name: views_post_update_views_data_argument_plugin_id
methods.description: Updates views data for entity reference argument plugin IDs, disables deprecations during update.

methods.name: views_post_update_format_plural
methods.description: Updates the format plural option for views using aggregation, disables deprecations during update.

methods.name: views_post_update_update_remember_role_empty
methods.description: Cleans up empty remember_roles display settings in views filters, disables deprecations during update.

methods.name: views_post_update_table_css_class
methods.description: Adds a default CSS class to views tables, disables deprecations during update.

methods.name: views_post_update_block_items_per_page
methods.description: Sets 'items_per_page' to NULL in views blocks where it is 'none'.

methods.name: views_post_update_add_date_default_arguments
methods.description: Triggers cache rebuild by updating default date arguments in views.
